items.text: A marshmallow out of the bag

title: Campfire Night: the roast, the sticks and the paw
kaylee: She takes a marshmallow from Maple's bag, it toasts on a stick propped over the fire, and when it looks like a friend's picture she feeds it to them.
questions: Does the new roast feel right to play: a marshmallow in her fingers and a stick that stays by the fire?

pictures.title: The little paw
pictures.caption: Its arm stuck out over the top of the bush with nobody on the end. Now it comes out of the leaves.

pictures.title: Sticks in paws
pictures.caption: Maple's stick hung below her paw. Every film stick and the puck now sit in the paw (Roxy's and the kits' too).

pictures.title: The roast
pictures.caption: No more stick floating in the air: it's propped over the fire, and she carries the marshmallow in front of everybody, so it goes through nobody.

pictures.title: Jev 3D glitch check
pictures.caption: Run on the changed screens in nine screen shapes (8 cents in all). No red box was a bug in the game. Detached prop on the roasting stick: not a bug, it is propped over the fire on purpose. Camera inside scenery on a QA-only close-up from behind the fire: fixed, the QA camera stands nearer (11 boxes down to 4, none in the game). Sunk into the ground on the film out, upright iPhone: not sunk; Maple and Roxy are cut off at the sides there, as before this change (in the notes). Maybes checked: none real. The full report on how Jev did is linked in the PR.
